$comment: Short form: one endpoint, one API key, model names one per line. A model with its own key: {"id": ..., "apiKey": ...}; all others use the main apiKey. An empty or missing list uses every model the endpoint reports. Save as ~/.kurultay/config.json (all projects) or kurultay.config.json in a project. "helper": an optional small model (e.g. on this PC) that only does summaries and context compaction.
